text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's the last day of summer camp. Vodka is staring out at the ocean by herself.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, hey. Is it already time for the bus to leave?
choice_data_list: We still have a little time. What's wrong?
We still have a little time. What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Nothin'. I was just reflectin' on our time at camp. I got in a lot better training than I expected to.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: On the beach, in the mountains, even on uneven ground… I really improved my sprinting a bunch.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I usually don't have the patience Scarlet does, so I didn't expect to get this far.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: But for some reason, I never got tired of training. Something kept pushing me on.
choice_data_list: Maybe it was the sense that you're getting cooler.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The sense that I'm… Y'know what, you might be right.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The whole time, I was thinking that I'd be cooler if I could just improve my acceleration.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hah, but it turns out that's no big deal. Doin' your best isn't about forcin' yourself…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's finding something you wanna try for. I think doin' that might be enough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We stand side by side and look up at the evening summer sky together.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I found it now, too, Scarlet. Something to be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All that's left is to take on number one… You.
